scenes.title: HOOK - three crosses, Golgotha
scenes.subject_block: Three crosses on the hill of Golgotha at midday beneath a dark storm sky; Jesus on the centre cross, wearing a simple pale robe fully covering his body, a THIN gaunt marred frame, NO heroic muscle; the two criminals crucified on either side of him; a small crowd gathered below in hushed shadow; the scene wide and desolate, deeply reverent and sorrowful.

scenes.title: the mocking thief
scenes.subject_block: One of the two criminals crucified beside Jesus, a rough weathered man, his face twisted in scorn and pain, sneering sideways off-frame toward the centre cross; rope-bound wrists on rough wood, harsh midday sun, no other figures close, no blood, restrained.

scenes.title: the penitent thief rebukes him
scenes.subject_block: The other crucified criminal, a gaunt weathered man, his face grave and honest, turning to rebuke the first thief beside him; both crosses visible close together, the centre cross with Jesus faintly beyond in the haze; harsh daylight, dust in the air, restrained, no blood.

scenes.title: his eyes turn toward Jesus
scenes.subject_block: Close on the penitent thief's weary, resigned face, his eyes now turning toward Jesus on the centre cross in the soft distance -- Jesus robed in simple pale cloth, thin and marred, head bowed -- a flicker of honesty and hope breaking through the thief's pain.

scenes.title: Lord, remember me
scenes.subject_block: The penitent thief straining toward Jesus on the centre cross, his face pleading, his bound hand slightly lifted toward him in a final request; Jesus present in the same frame, wearing a simple pale robe fully covering his body, a thin gaunt marred frame, bowed in sorrow on the cross.

scenes.title: Jesus turns his head
scenes.subject_block: Jesus on the cross turning his head gently toward the penitent thief beside him, wearing a simple pale robe fully covering his body, a thin gaunt marred frame, NO heroic muscle, his face full of compassion; storm clouds parting faintly with a soft light behind him.

scenes.title: today shalt thou be with me
scenes.subject_block: Close on Jesus's face on the cross, wearing a simple pale robe fully covering his body, gaunt and marred yet radiant with tenderness, speaking gently to the thief beside him; a soft break of light in the storm clouds behind his head; deeply reverent, no bright blood.

scenes.title: LANDING - the gate of light
scenes.subject_block: The risen Christ standing in a gate of golden light breaking through parted storm clouds above Golgotha, wearing a simple luminous undyed white robe, one hand extended toward the viewer in welcome, warm and radiant; the crosses small and distant below; reverent, hopeful, inviting, the landing.
